scientific_boundary: The Earth-fixed target cell is independently anchored by EM12. The unresolved link is frozen Earth-cell -> defensible TOBI feature replication at that same cell. This outreach seeks historical vehicle-navigation provenance only; it does not seek a new fitted navigation solution.
requested_items: CD169 PRISM-derived *.veh_nav / navfile.veh_nav or equivalent intermediate TOBI vehicle-navigation output
CD169 commands.cfg, shell scripts, processing logs, history files, or README material containing wireout and/or mrgnav_inertia invocation
exact PRISM version used for CD169 and corresponding manual/source/binary provenance if available
original processing-directory file listing/inventory if the intermediate files no longer survive
why_requested: The exposed archive contains cd169.nav and cd169.cable plus raw2prism-era CDF products.
All 102040 archived CDF latlon rows are zero-zero despite metadata describing latlon as sonar position, consistent with a pre-mrgnav or navigation-not-merged stage.
Cruise/platform-specific wireout and mrgnav_inertia parameters vary historically, so parameters from another cruise must not be transferred to CD169 without provenance.
Authoritative historical processing provenance is required before remapping the frozen-cell raw sample or promoting a ground-fixed TOBI feature claim.
explicit_non_request: Do not require modern reprocessing as a substitute for historical provenance.
Do not fit a new V4 navigation model inside V3.
Do not recenter the frozen Earth-cell to a stronger sonar sample.

response_handling_gate.if_native_veh_nav_received: HASH_ORIGINAL_BYTES -> verify time coverage -> compare against science-log anchors without tuning -> remap frozen cell geometrically -> inspect only resulting sample
response_handling_gate.if_commands_or_exact_wireout_config_rece: HASH_OR_CAPTURE_PROVENANCE -> reproduce exact historical chain without fitting -> held-out anchor validation -> remap only after pass
response_handling_gate.if_only_directory_listing_received: Use as provenance evidence to identify original intermediate filenames/stages; do not treat listing alone as vehicle coordinates
response_handling_gate.if_no_intermediate_provenance_exists: Keep G3A/G3C blocked and preserve V2 sample 821 as approximate only
